release_notes:
## One output folder for everything (Manual mode)
- Manual mode now has a "Send every version to one folder" option. Tick it and the LIVE box becomes ALL VERSIONS — every LIVE, MARKETING, TRAILER and SRT file renders into that single folder, with the filenames telling them apart
- The per-version boxes grey out while it is on, and only that one folder needs filling in before you can queue
- Leave it unticked for the existing behaviour, a separate folder per version. The option doesn't appear in Auto mode, where the folders are detected for you
